steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. Each requirement needs an acceptance criterion and a business need, and each field must be on the list.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Requirement with no acceptance criterion
findings.fix: Write the criterion as a test

findings.title: Field named that is not on the field list
findings.fix: Use a field on the list or add it

outcome.notChecked: Whether the change is technically feasible.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.

pros: Checks a requirement with no acceptance criterion, a requirement with no business need, and a field named that is not in the current field list.
cons: Not checked: Whether the change is technically feasible.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-sales-crm-requirements skill on the records for this review.
